basics.name: Veli-Matti Seppälä
basics.label: Senior Software Developer and Partner
basics.summary:
Vemmu is an experienced frontend focused developer with a good grasp on usability and accessibility. He is not afraid of working with the backend either. His passion is creating services that are easy to use. Vemmu likes to use his critical thinking to challenge designs and ways of working and spar ideas with other team members. He often becomes a key player in a team by taking responsibility and supporting everyone.

Vemmu has experience in developing services used both by experts for work and for the public. He has worked on many greenfield projects, smaller gigs and major overhauls.

To compensate all the screen time at work and with pc games, Vemmu enjoys nature and outdoor activities. He has also built a hobby web application of his own with SvelteKit and Vercel.
basics.x-tagline: Things should be simple. Developers carry the responsibility of building services that are accessible and easy to use, and I build them for people, together with people.

x-strengths.title: Frontend development
x-strengths.description: Vemmu has lots of experience with React from the first days of Redux to the latest state management solutions. He is a fan of Svelte and hopes to see it become more mainstream.

x-strengths.title: Accessible by default
x-strengths.description: Vemmu has developed services with AA-level accessibility requirements and is familiar with accessibility guidelines.

x-strengths.title: Key team player
x-strengths.description: The big picture is always on Vemmu's mind. He always considers the whole solution and does not settle for just finishing tickets.

x-keyRoles.title: React wizard
x-keyRoles.description: Vemmu has been using React since its early years and knows how to implement applications with a good architecture.

x-keyRoles.title: Team guide
x-keyRoles.description: Vemmu is good at remembering the big picture and is happy to help others. He takes responsibility and eagerly takes part in discussions.

x-keyRoles.title: Friend of designers
x-keyRoles.description: Sparring with designers and giving opinions on both UX and how to best implement the suggested design is what Vemmu really likes to do. Colleagues have jokingly called him an honorary member of the design team.

x-keyRoles.title: Accessibility expert
x-keyRoles.description: Implementing applications with strict accessibility requirements have made Vemmu very familiar with WCAG guidelines.

basics.x-hobbies: Enjoys nature and outdoor activities, and PC games; builds hobby web applications in his free time.

projects.description: Responsible for frontend development of the new services for both personal and corporate use. Also worked on the Python backend and with the client's design system component library.
